about.title: Why the LORIS Electric Shepherd?
about.p1: Every day, farmers face major challenges in **monitoring and protecting their livestock**, which takes a heavy toll on their time and energy.
about.p2: The Electric Shepherd was created as the **smart, modern solution** that delivers comfort and safety at once.
about.imageAlt: The Electric Shepherd working in the field

features.title: How does the LORIS Electric Shepherd work?
features.p1: The device relies on **mild, harmless electric shocks** that keep livestock within the boundaries of the pasture — no constant guarding required.
features.p2: It runs on a **powerful battery lasting up to 50 hours**, and can be recharged with solar power in areas away from the grid.

stats.title: Trusted by farmers and livestock breeders across the country.
stats.paragraph: The Electric Shepherd has won the satisfaction of hundreds of farmers and livestock breeders across many regions, thanks to the comfort, safety, and ease of use it provides. Many of our users say they have saved hours of daily guarding and can now manage their herds with complete confidence — no fear of escape or loss. The device has proven its effectiveness in open fields and mountainous areas, and has become the first choice for any farmer looking for a practical solution that protects the herd and saves effort.

faq.title: Everything you want to know about the LORIS Electric Shepherd

items.q: Does the Electric Shepherd harm livestock?
items.a: No — the electric shocks are mild and completely safe. Their sole purpose is to deter the animal when it tries to cross the fence, without causing it any harm.

items.q: How long does the Electric Shepherd's battery last?
items.a: Up to 50 hours of continuous operation. It recharges easily from the mains, or with solar power in remote areas.

items.q: Can it be used on every type of terrain?
items.a: Yes — it performs efficiently in open fields, mountain farms, and desert areas, thanks to a design that resists harsh conditions.

items.q: What does the Electric Shepherd kit include?
items.a: It includes the original device, the carrying wire, insulators, clips, the original charger, and a user manual — everything you need to run it right away.

items.q: Is it easy to install and operate?
items.a: Absolutely. The device comes with a clear, illustrated user manual that explains the installation step by step — anyone can set it up in minutes.
